quest.title: Forested Snowfield
quest.description: While passing a lumberyard south of Morepesok, you unexpectedly ran into some Volkodlaks harassing the local workers... Looks like it's trouble stirred up by gang members again? Seems like it's time for you to step in.

dialogues.speaker: Dashkov
dialogues.text: The great detective of Chicota? Of course I've heard of you. But like I've said time and time again—

dialogues.speaker: Dashkov
dialogues.text: There's nothing illegal going on here. Everything's above board and entirely consensual... Hey, Ikita! Tell the detective — have I said a single false word?

dialogues.speaker: Dashkov
dialogues.text: Oh, right. This fellow's an old gambling addict. Gambled away everything he had to pawn except himself and his family.

dialogues.speaker: Dashkov
dialogues.text: It was us, the Izmaylov, who gave him a chance to work off what he owed. Once his debt's paid, he gets to go home to his family.

dialogues.speaker: Dashkov
dialogues.text: If it'd been some other gang... well, he might never have seen them again. Isn't that right, Ikita?

dialogues.speaker: Iguita
dialogues.text: Yes... I owe Izmaylov money. I'm working here of my own free will to pay off my debt...

dialogues.speaker: Dashkov
dialogues.text: There you have it, detective. You heard it straight from him. Nothing to see here.
I don't believe it... Not a single one of them has any life in their eyes. There's no way this is a normal workplace.
I want to question the workers in private. No members of the Izmaylov are to be present.

dialogues.speaker: Dashkov
dialogues.text: *sigh*... So we're done playing nice, huh? Detective, your friends must've told you you're terrible at reading the room.
What? N—No one's ever said that to me!

dialogues.speaker: Dashkov
dialogues.text: Oh? Then I suppose you've never had anyone you'd actually call a friend. Can't say I'm surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Dashkov
dialogues.text: Here's the bad news: everyone here is my friend. And they all happen to share one admirable quality — they know how to keep their mouths shut.
What were you talking about...

dialogues.speaker: Dashkov
dialogues.text: I mean that no matter what happens to you here... no one's ever going to hear about it.

dialogues.speaker: Sarvov
dialogues.text: Phew... we're saved! Chicota finally came to rescue us...

dialogues.speaker: Kietta
dialogues.text: Detective, they're heavily outnumbering us. We barely managed to break through and escape, so you have to be careful too!

dialogues.speaker: Kietta
dialogues.text: Even a whole squad might struggle... Detective, where's your team?

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: Everyone assigned to this operation is right here.

dialogues.speaker: Sarvov
dialogues.text: Only three people? No... Two and a half?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Donya doesn't exactly look like she can operate independently as a detective, so she only counts as half...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! That's just rude. Are you looking down on me or something?

dialogues.speaker: Sarvov
dialogues.text: Sorry, sorry... I just mean, with only a few of you, I'm worried you might not be a match for the leader of the Izmaylov.

dialogues.speaker: Sarvov
dialogues.text: Gusarov is guarding the stronghold... just thinking about him makes me feel like I've stepped into a frozen pit on the tundra — my heart practically stops.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So how did you manage to escape?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Right! With so many strong guards at the stronghold, how did you three get out? Unless... unless you were deliberately let go... Oh, Paimon sees how things turned out here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It must be a scheme by Izmaylov!

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: Hold on! I'm the detective here — the deduction part should be left to me.

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: Ahem. You're not ordinary workers at all... you're bait released by Izmaylov...

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: The goal is to lure us — preferably as many as possible — into a prepared pocket, and wipe us all out in one sweep!

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: Confess! That's your plan, isn't it!? I'm a trained detective. Don't think your tricks will work on me!

dialogues.speaker: Kietta
dialogues.text: Uh... no, detective. I bribed the guards. But we were spotted right after escaping, which is why there are pursuers behind us...

dialogues.speaker: Sarvov
dialogues.text: We were really worried about you. If anything happened to you, our lives would get even harder than before...

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: Waaah, this is so embarrassing... I thought I could calmly reveal the truth like my seniors, but it turns out I completely misunderstood...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on, aren't you a detective? Isn't it a bit reckless to believe them so easily!?

choices.text: But what they said does make some sense.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, then we'll stick to the original plan... and head to the stronghold first!

choices.text: Forget it. Let's just fight our way through first.

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help earlier. I'm Detective Donya from Ch{RUBY#[S]Snezhnaya Royal Railway Transport Bureau}icota. You can just call me Donya. May I ask your names?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{M#He's}{F#She's} {NICKNAME}, and Paimon's Paimon! We're... adventurers who can't stand injustice and step in whenever trouble shows up!

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: I see. Still, I've made a fool of myself in front of you two. I'm not very good at negotiation... Even though I promised myself I wouldn't act on impulse before coming here, I still ended up...

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: It really does shame me compared to the teachings of my seniors. But I do remember one thing they said: "The mark of a qualified detective is the courage to step forward at the critical moment!"

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: I suppose... at least on that point, I am "qualified"! Let's just say that earlier counted as one of those "critical moments"!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So basically... anything counts as a "critical moment" if you step in?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's exactly how it should be! If you don't even have the courage to step up, how can you call yourself a detective...? Oh, right — are you two here to rescue the lumberyard workers?

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: It's a bit embarrassing to say... My mission was actually a preliminary investigation — an undercover operation into Izmaylov's personnel arrangements in this area before the final sweep.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An undercover operation? But we already beat up their people earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: Yes... Though we've already alerted them — no, you could say we've triggered a full confrontation. Still, I've managed to pinpoint the location of their stronghold.

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: At this point, I'll have to carry out the final sweep myself!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're planning to take them all on alone?

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: Yes. It seems that right after one "critical moment," another one has arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh, let's put all this "critical moment" talk aside for now. {NICKNAME} and I will help too.

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: What wonderfully kind adventurers! If only all adventurers were as helpful as you two...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We can't just stand by and watch you get surrounded instead of doing the surrounding.

talks.objective: Follow Donya to the gang's stronghold

dialogues.speaker: Gusarov
dialogues.text: Lukyanov, I've been hearing more and more reports of workers refusing to obey and trying to escape. Care to explain yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Lekotanov
dialogues.text: I take full responsibility, Boss. But... they've been swallowing all those rumors whole. That's what's made them so much bolder...

dialogues.speaker: Gusarov
dialogues.text: Rumors... You mean the ones about the Young Sire falling from power?

dialogues.speaker: Lekotanov
dialogues.text: Exactly. And the boys have also spotted Chicota's hounds sniffing around these past few days. I doubt it'll be long before they make their move.

dialogues.speaker: Lekotanov
dialogues.text: If the Young Sire can't send reinforcements, I'm afraid we won't be able to hold this territory on our own.

dialogues.speaker: Lekotanov
dialogues.text: Boss, if you ask me... now that we've lost our backer, why don't we seize the <color=#00E1FFFF>"legendary thief's treasure"</color> while we still can? Maybe we won't be living the high life, but at least we'll have something to fall back on...

dialogues.speaker: Gusarov
dialogues.text: Hmm... Even without the Young Sire, the Energy Commission is still around. Sooner or later, they'll have use for the Izmaylov again. We need to weigh the pros and cons carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Lekotanov
dialogues.text: You're right, Boss... But if we let this opportunity slip away—

dialogues.speaker: Ismaylov Thug
dialogues.text: B—Boss! Chicota's here!

dialogues.speaker: Gusarov
dialogues.text: What!? Already? How many of them are there?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lay down your weapons! If you surrender now, we'll take your cooperation into consideration!

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: P—Paimon! Chicota detectives aren't supposed to negotiate with criminals!

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: And this was supposed to be my "critical moment"... You two stole all the spotlight... Hmph...

response.speaker: Gusarov
response.text: You've got to be kidding me... Just the three of you? The Izmaylov hasn't fallen that low!

response.speaker: Gusarov
response.text: Boys, grab your weapons! Show them what happens when they cross us!

choices.text: The detectives of Chicota have you surrounded!

talks.objective: Defeat the gang members occupying this area

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After some effort, you manage to stuff the defeated Izmaylov members into a nearby cabin...

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: It's locked. Now we just need to notify my colleagues to come take them into custody.

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: #And thank you both for your help. This was my first time carrying out a mission on my own. Without you, {NICKNAME}, I don't even want to think about how it would've ended...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean your very first solo mission ended with you taking on an entire criminal syndicate!?

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: Well, I stepped up at the critical moment and brought down a criminal organization. I'd call that quite an achievement! Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I guess you could say that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not the point! Just because things turned out okay doesn't mean the ends justify the means!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, what about all those workers?

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: If you're worried about them, why don't we go check on them? I know where they'll be. Follow me.

choices.text: An organization has no place for people who refuse to follow orders!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What kind of organization are we talking about!? But... Paimon guesses you're right. Rules are important, no matter what organization you're in.

talks.objective: Defeat the gang members occupying this area

dialogues.speaker: Gusarov
dialogues.text: Hmph... Not bad. You've got some real skill. No point throwing our lives away here... We'll settle this another day!

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: #Ah! My "critical moment" is getting away! {NICKNAME}, quick! Let's go after them!

talks.objective: Catch up to the fleeing gang members
Defeat the gang members occupying this area

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: Detectives! The detectives are here!

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: I'm sorry... Something went wrong with the operation. The plan had to change...

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: W—What!? D—Don't tell me they found out! Oh no... What are we going to do?

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: The Izmaylov will never let us go... We're going to die here!

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: No, we have to leave. Now. Before their thugs show up... *sigh*... There goes my lumberyard... My livelihood...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, hang on! Donya's mission may have gone off the rails, but everything's been taken care of!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain what happened earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: ...So you're saying the thugs who seized my lumberyard have all been brought to justice? We don't have to live in fear anymore?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At least for now. Though... I can't promise they won't come back someday.

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter. If they dare to show their faces again, I'll do my duty. In the name of the Chicota Detectives, I'll bring them to justice all over again!

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: Oh, that's reassuring! Then we'll be counting on you.

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: *sigh* But after everything the Izmaylov did to this place... They didn't just exploit and abuse the workers — they trashed the tools and equipment, too...

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: Getting the lumberyard up and running again is going to cost a fortune... And I don't even know where that money will come from...

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: Hey! A "critical moment" can't solve that... Um, wait. No. My senior did say something once:

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: "When it's time to make a decision, stop, think calmly, and then act. That's the critical moment before the critical moment."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How many "critical moments" are there!? You could string them together into a chain! And besides...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If there's a "critical moment" for staying calm and thinking things through, maybe you should've used that one a little earlier! You charged in without thinking more times than Paimon can count!

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: Hmm... I see now! The critical moment!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What is it? Are you going to beat up the lumberyard until it fixes itself?

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: N—No! I really do have an idea this time. Right before we fought the Izmaylov gang leader...

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: He mentioned something... What was it...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The "legendary thief's treasure"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Come to think of it, didn't we find a map with a marked location earlier?

response.speaker: Gerik
response.text: Huh? But according to the map, it's the place we already dug up... Wait, all we found there was a bunch of solid ice...

response.speaker: Gerik
response.text: Could that have been...? Uh... Anyway, I'll take you there first.

choices.text: Come on! Use your "critical moment" to save the day!

talks.objective: Go to the location of the buried treasure

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: Wow! That's a huge block of ice... Hm, if you look closely, is there something inside it?

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: Inside...? Ah, so the "legendary thief's treasure" is sealed within it. We thought it was just a pile of rocks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But this ice hasn't melted at all, even after all this time.

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: That's just how Snezhnaya's weather is. Ice like this on the tundra only gets bigger if you leave it alone.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The "critical moment"...

dialogues.speaker: Donya
dialogues.text: No matter how critical it is, it's not going to break ice!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We just need something warm to melt it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, didn't we come across that strange Prime Ice device before...? Maybe we can use that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's give it a try!

talks.objective: Melt the ice to obtain the "legendary thief's treasure"

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: So this is what those Izmaylov guys were after... They took over my lumberyard just for this.

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: So much Mora... Even just a small portion of it would be enough to get the lumberyard running again.

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: But I heard the Adventurers' Guild rules say that any unclaimed treasure found in the wild belongs to whoever discovers it...

choices.text: You're quite sharp — correct, it all belongs to me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! It all belongs to us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Wait, isn't that exactly the kind of thing those Izmaylov villains would say!? If we're taking it, we should at least leave some for the others!

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: Huh? I get a share too? Wow, I can live pretty comfortably until my next payday...

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: N—No, wait! Donya, snap out of it! This is a "critical moment" for your test! How can I be corrupted so easily!?

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: ...Ahem. I'll leave the handling of this treasure to you all.

response.speaker: Gerik
response.text: Then... thank you for your kindness. I'll just take a small portion to repair the lumberyard's facilities and tools. The rest can go to the adventurer who contributed the most.

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: No objections.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, then it's settled! But Donia, you'll still need to contact your colleagues to handle the aftermath, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I wonder what your seniors will say when they find out you cleaned up an Izmaylov stronghold all by yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe instead of praise, you'll get scolded!

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: T—That shouldn't be the case... but now that I think about it, it's not entirely impossible... What should I do...? Wait...

response.speaker: Donya
response.text: #I've got it — {NICKNAME} and Paimon will become my "critical moment"! That way, my seniors will definitely understand!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No way!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No way! And what even is a "critical moment" anymore!? Paimon's getting more and more confused!

choices.text: If it's finders keepers, then let's split it evenly.

dialogues.speaker: Galiobo
dialogues.text: It's no use... It's all pointless anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Gerik
dialogues.text: Is there some kind of Prime Ice device that can melt a block of ice this huge?

dialogues.speaker: Kietta
dialogues.text: Marfa... Ugh, I wonder how Marfa's doing now...

dialogues.speaker: Gusarov
dialogues.text: Alright then. So you're really planning to settle this with me today, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Gusarov
dialogues.text: Fine! Bring it on! Boys, come out! Let's show this damn cop what we're made of!

dialogues.speaker: Lekotanov
dialogues.text: Get him, boys!
